decisions.reason: Although it has not been visibly promoted recently, it is a recently developed add-on tied to the firm's web-map stack, so sunk development effort and the low cost of continuing a modular bundle favor retention.

Its weaker original visibility and later absence make it one of the more vulnerable launches, but because it sits close to the established offering management is still more likely to keep it than admit the development was not worthwhile.
The product had prominent public launch visibility and supports mobile usability in the firm's core GIS domain, so management can still justify continuation despite limited later evidence.
As the flagship platform line linked to the firm's stated strategic direction, it carries the strongest public commitment and is therefore very unlikely to be withdrawn.

Mobile field data capture fits naturally with integrated geospatial enterprise solutions, and its dedicated presentation suggests enough prior commitment that management would be reluctant to discontinue it quickly.

This search extension remains close to the firm's core web-map business and likely benefits from reuse within broader solutions, which makes continued support more likely than withdrawal even with lower recent visibility.
